description: Marketplace hubs — four department boards with browse actions and 2×2 product tiles (RTL/LTR).

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ArrowUpRightIcon } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import burgerImg from "./images/burger.webp" import coffeeImg from "./images/coffee.webp" import desktopImg from "./images/desktop.webp" import food1Img from "./images/food-1.webp" import food2Img from "./images/food-2.webp" import laptop1Img from "./images/laptop-1.webp" import laptop2Img from "./images/laptop-2.webp" import laptop3Img from "./images/laptop-3.webp" import organicImg from "./images/organic.webp" import sunCreamImg from "./images/sun-cream.webp" import sunglassImg from "./images/sunglass.webp" import sunscreenAImg from "./images/sunscreen-a.webp" import sunscreenBImg from "./images/sunscreen-b.webp" import watch1Img from "./images/watch-1.webp" import watch2Img from "./images/watch-2.webp" function assetSrc(asset: string | { src: string }) { return typeof asset === "string" ? asset : asset.src } const SECTIONS = [ { id: "trending-heading", title: "Trending & Celebration Picks", eyebrow: "Now hot", items: [ { name: "Watches", img: assetSrc(watch1Img) }, { name: "Laptops", img: assetSrc(laptop1Img) }, { name: "Sun Glasses", img: assetSrc(sunglassImg) }, { name: "Sunscreen", img: assetSrc(sunscreenAImg) }, ], }, { id: "food-heading", title: "Food and Beverage", eyebrow: "Pantry", items: [ { name: "Snakes Food", img: assetSrc(food1Img) }, { name: "Hot Coffee", img: assetSrc(coffeeImg) }, { name: "Snakes", img: assetSrc(food2Img) }, { name: "Burger King", img: assetSrc(burgerImg) }, ], }, { id: "electronics-heading", title: "Plug in with Electronics", eyebrow: "Devices", items: [ { name: "Windows Laptops", img: assetSrc(laptop2Img) }, { name: "Smart Watches", img: assetSrc(watch2Img) }, { name: "Desktops", img: assetSrc(desktopImg) }, { name: "Laptop", img: assetSrc(laptop3Img) }, ], }, { id: "beauty-heading", title: "Beauty and Cosmetics", eyebrow: "Glow", items: [ { name: "Sunscreen", img: assetSrc(sunscreenBImg) }, { name: "Sun Cream", img: assetSrc(sunCreamImg) }, { name: "Organics Cream", img: assetSrc(organicImg) }, { name: "Skin Care", img: assetSrc(sunscreenAImg) }, ], }, ] as const export default function ProductCategories({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) { return (

Marketplace hubs

Shop by department

{SECTIONS.map((section) => (

{section.eyebrow}

{section.title}

    {section.items.map((item) => (

  • {item.name}

    • ))}
))}
) }
